description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST ai publisher filters new. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Creates a scheduled AI Publisher publication order for the selected store, including search conditions copied from the catalog. ownerAgent: ai-publisher. Use when: Use to create an order with product conditions, quantity, schedule and optimization preferences. Input: NewFiltersRequest.Filter: supplier Sources, OnlyPrime, optional Criteria (the free-text search prompt, up to 4000 characters; not a literal title substring), PriceMin/PriceMax, ProfitMin/ProfitMax and optional Tags (array of separate integer IDs, not bit flags). Tag IDs: 1 Valentine's Day, 2 Mother's Day, 3 Father's Day, 4 Back to school, 5 Halloween, 6 Black Friday, 7 Cyber Monday, 8 Christmas, 9 New Year's Eve, 10 Prime Day, 11 Trending, 12 Home and garden, 13 Electronics, 14 Toys and games, 15 Health and beauty, 16 Sports, 17 Pet supplies. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId; the selected store determines ChannelOauthId. Output: Returns the identifier of the created order. Search terms: ai publisher filters new. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.
